dct_description_sm:
YEC Power Distribution Lines depict Yukon Energy Corporation (YEC) primary distribution lines. These lines distribute lower voltage electrical power between Power Substations and consumers (e.g. communities, mines). This data was provided by YEC and will be updated when new primary distribution lines are constructed.

Distributed from [GeoYukon](https://yukon.ca/geoyukon) by the [Government of Yukon](https://yukon.ca/maps) . Discover more digital map data and interactive maps from Yukon's digital map data collection.

For more information: [geomatics.help@yukon.ca](mailto:geomatics.help@yukon.ca)
